driver: Chargeback policy missing from knowledge base
finding: A new chargeback rule for disputed card payments went live on 6 Oct. The agent still quotes the old rule, so customers dispute the answer and ask for a person.
fix: Publish the policy article with 12 example answers, then re-test on 200 sampled conversations

driver: "Duplicate payment" classified as "pending payment" since release 3.14
finding: After release 3.14, conversations that mention "charged twice" are routed to the pending-payment flow, which cannot reverse a payment.
fix: Retrain the intent model on 400 labelled conversations and add a regression test to the release checklist

driver: Subscription double-charge flow ends without a refund
finding: The agent recognises a double subscription charge and confirms it, then closes the conversation without triggering the refund step.
fix: Add the refund action to the flow, with a guardrail for amounts up to 20 EUR

driver: More payment contacts in the mix
finding: Payments rose from 34% to 39% of contacts. Payments resolve below the market average, so the overall rate falls even with no change in quality.
fix: No fix needed; report it separately so it is not mistaken for a quality drop

driver: Card freeze flow now resolves end to end
finding: A new step lets the agent freeze and reissue a lost card within the conversation, so these cases close without a person.
fix: Reuse the same in-conversation action pattern for duplicate payments
